author: Chob75
title: [RevShare][Art][SFW/NSFW] Looking for pixelartist to help me finish my darkest dungeon inspired game
content: Hi! Im Chob, a last year software engineer student with experience working on a couple of small game projects. I am currently working on a passion project that takes heavy inspiration on darkest dungeon but with a more comedic and lighthearted approach while still keeping some of its characteristic darkness. I have already developed the basic core loop of the game. For contact I prefer if you reach out to my discord (chob75) since I dont check on this site often.

author: CopacaBella
title: [ART][UI] ARTIST & UI FOR 2000s NOSTALGIA STORY GAME
content: Hi! Looking for 2D artists, animators, or UI/UX designers for a story-driven game about logging onto your missing sister's old computer to figure out what happened to her. Set in the mid-2000s: Vista/XP aesthetics, Frutiger Aero, Messenger pings, browser games, Club Penguin-era internet nostalgia. Reach out via itch.io thread.

author: kamii0
title: [LFS] [Unpaid/Revshare] [Art] Seeking Art Lead for 3D Japanese Psychological Horror (UE5 Vertical Slice)
content: Hi everyone! I'm the Creative Director behind Jizo no Akumu, a 3D third-person psychological horror game built in Unreal Engine 5. We are seeking an Art Lead (or senior 3D Generalist ready to step into leadership) to guide our art direction and mentor our existing 3D artists. Contact method: Apply via post with portfolio link and Discord handle.

author: EntangledRedPanda
title: [2D VFX] [PAID] Looking for Unity VFX Artist experienced with Shaders ($25-35/hr)
content: Hey everyone! I've been developing a 2D arena shooter game with bioelectrical creatures in Unity for over a year. I'm looking for a VFX artist to help with development, adding/polishing atmospheric, weapon, and environmental particle effects using shaders. Contact via private messages on itch.io.

author: onlyfortress
title: [2d Art][Paid/Revenue Share] Looking for a 2D artist for my live 4x mobile game
content: Hello all! I have been developing my own game for almost 5 years. It is in a genre of 4x strategy where you control your own character, build buildings, control troops and do open world exploration. The game is mobile only with 12k downloads on Google Play (4.8 rating). Currently my game uses free assets with 2d 45 angle perspective. I want to change every single asset to be made by a single person in a unique & consistent style. Contact via reply on itch.io thread.

title: Senior UI Artist
content: We are building a new mobile strategy game from the ground up, and we need a Senior UI Artist who can help define its visual identity from day one. You will shape how the UI looks, moves, and feels, and build it yourself directly in Unity. Position is Remote / Contract. Apply directly via ArtStation listing.

title: [2D][PAID] Looking for Character Artist + Background Artist — Gothic Regency-Inspired Visual Novel

author: Lance (Fables of Humanity)
title: Epic Cover Album Artist Wanted
content: Hi, I'm Lance, I write symphonic fantasy metal music for my project Fables of Humanity, which has a strong theme around LOTR, Viking, and Original Mythology. I'm getting ready to launch my first album this year. I'm looking for an artist to create artwork for my album cover. I want the finished product to look authentic, more like a painting than just straight digital. Contact via ArtStation application or fablesofhumanity.com.
